item.title: Draft Cabinet Order revising compensation for part-time volunteer firefighters and others
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications' Fire and Disaster Management Agency published for public comment on 2026-11-19 a draft amending the Cabinet Order establishing compensation standards for part-time volunteer firefighters and others; the stated deadline was 2026-12-18 at 23:59 JST. The draft would raise compensation base amounts by JPY 400 across the rank-and-service categories for part-time volunteer firefighters and flood-defense corps members, and raise the minimum and maximum for firefighting workers, emergency-service cooperators and flood-defense workers from JPY 10,000–15,000 to JPY 10,400–15,400. It would remove the age-or-disability eligibility condition for surviving husbands, while retaining it for parents and grandparents, and set the survivor compensation pension for a sole survivor uniformly at 175 times the compensation base amount instead of the existing 153-times amount with a specified exception. Promulgation is planned for early February 2027, with commencement on 2027-04-01. The proposed provisions would apply to compensation-triggering events occurring on or after that date and to specified injury-and-disease compensation pensions and related benefits for periods from that date even where the triggering event occurred earlier. item.title: Public-comment results on draft Notice amending Fixed Asset Valuation Standards
item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-18, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications published consultation results for a draft Notice amending the Fixed Asset Valuation Standards. Consultation ran from 2026-09-16 to 2026-10-20, with 11 respondents; the ministry reported no changes to the consulted draft and said the comments would inform future consideration. Submitted comments describe proposed fiscal 2027 reconstruction-cost point adjustment factors for existing buildings of 1.16 for wooden buildings and 1.20 for non-wooden buildings, compared with fiscal 2024 factors of 1.11 and 1.07, respectively. Comments also describe extending transitional treatment for the value per valuation point through fiscal 2029 and changing wooden-building regional price adjustment factors for Morioka and Fukushima from 0.90 to 0.95. Those details appear in respondents' descriptions rather than the draft instrument itself; the excerpts do not establish promulgation or an effective date. item.title: Draft ordinance and notice amendments on mobile-service incentives and MVNO regulation
item.description: AI summary: The proposed Ministerial Ordinance would relax restrictions on benefits conditional on new mobile-service contracts, allowing installment-based provision of communication-fee discounts and other benefits within a JPY 20,000 ceiling. It would also subject mobile virtual network operators (MVNOs) to the relevant rules when their contract share for regulated services exceeds 4%, regardless of affiliation with a mobile network operator (MNO); the proposed Notice would remove designations of MNO-affiliated MVNOs. The package would amend the Regulations for Enforcement of the Telecommunications Business Act and Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications Notice No. 291 of 2023, under the Telecommunications Business Act (Act No. 86 of 1984). The Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications consultation was announced in a document dated 2026-11-18 and listed on 2026-11-19, with a stated comment deadline of 2026-12-18 at 23:59 JST; postal submissions may bear the deadline date's postmark. The excerpts do not establish an effective date.
